blocks.html: Minor portions of public plazas are secondary areas that allow for additional flexibility in the shape and configuration of a public plaza. Minor portions shall not occupy more than 25 percent of the total area of the public plaza. The width of a minor portion shall be measured parallel to the line separating the major and minor portions. The depth of a minor portion shall be measured perpendicular to the line separating the major and minor portions. The provisions of Section 37-715 (Requirements for major portions of public plazas) shall not apply to such minor portions and the following regulations shall apply:
blocks.plainText: Minor portions of public plazas are secondary areas that allow for additional flexibility in the shape and configuration of a public plaza. Minor portions shall not occupy more than 25 percent of the total area of the public plaza. The width of a minor portion shall be measured parallel to the line separating the major and minor portions. The depth of a minor portion shall be measured perpendicular to the line separating the major and minor portions. The provisions of Section 37-715 (Requirements for major portions of public plazas) shall not apply to such minor portions and the following regulations shall apply:

blocks.html: (a)        The minor portion shall have a minimum average width and depth of 15 feet.
blocks.plainText: (a) The minor portion shall have a minimum average width and depth of 15 feet.

blocks.html: (b)        The minor portion must be directly adjacent to the major portion.
blocks.plainText: (b) The minor portion must be directly adjacent to the major portion.

blocks.html: (c)        All points within the minor portion must be visible from within the major portion when viewed perpendicular to the line separating the major and minor portions.
blocks.plainText: (c) All points within the minor portion must be visible from within the major portion when viewed perpendicular to the line separating the major and minor portions.

blocks.plainText: (d) The minor portion must front directly on a street adjoining the major portion, unless the minor portion has:

blocks.html: (1)        a width to depth ratio of at least 3:1; and
blocks.plainText: (1) a width to depth ratio of at least 3:1; and

blocks.html: (2)        its longest dimension contiguous with the major portion.
